info.title: Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform RESTful API

tags.name: Forensics
tags.description: The Forensics module facilitates deep analysis into the actual internals of the communicating devices operating system that led up to an event.

get.description: This API call retrieves a file or memory

parameters.name: disk
parameters.description: A true/false parameter indicating whether find in the disk

parameters.name: endRange
parameters.description: Specifies the memory end range, in Hexadecimal format

parameters.name: filePaths
parameters.description: Specifies the list of file paths

parameters.name: memory
parameters.description: A true/false parameter indicating whether find in the memory

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly

parameters.name: processId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the process from which to take a memory image. required for memory base action

parameters.name: rawEventId
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of the raw event on which to perform the memory retrieval

parameters.name: startRange
parameters.description: Specifies the memory start range, in Hexadecimal format

200.description: This operation results in a file stream (binary data), which is a .zip file

get.description: This API call retrieves a file or memory

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Specifies the name or id of the device to remediate

parameters.name: filePaths
parameters.description: Specifies the list of file paths

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Specifies the device parameter type used in the request : Name or ID

200.description: This operation results in a file stream (binary data), which is a .zip file

put.description: This API kill process / delete file / clean persistence, File and persistence paths must be specified in a logical format

parameters.name: device
parameters.description: Specifies the name of the device to remediate. You must specify a value for either device or deviceId (see below)

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Specifies the unique identifier (ID) of the device to remediate. You must specify a value for either deviceId or device (see above)

parameters.name: executablesToRemove
parameters.description:
Specifies the list of full paths of executable files (*.exe) to delete on the
given device

parameters.name: organization
parameters.description: Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly

parameters.name: persistenceDataAction
parameters.description: persistence data desired action

parameters.name: persistenceDataNewContent
parameters.description: persistence data new content

parameters.name: persistenceDataPath
parameters.description: persistence data path

parameters.name: persistenceDataValueName
parameters.description: persistence data value name

parameters.name: persistenceDataValueNewType
parameters.description: persistence data value new type

parameters.name: processName
parameters.description: Specifies the process name

parameters.name: terminatedProcessId
parameters.description: Represents the process ID to terminate on the device

parameters.name: threadId
parameters.description: Specifies the thread ID
